### Preach Christ, Embody Christ: How to Set an Example in Love
Author: Ray Ortlund
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/preach-christ-embody-christ
Passage: 1 Timothy 4:12
Points:
- Pastoral leadership requires demonstrating Christ's love through personal character rather than relying solely on sound doctrine.
- Faithful ministry demands costly sacrifice and generous exertion instead of self-protective minimalism.
- A godly leader focuses on cherishing and serving others rather than pursuing personal prestige.
- Living out patient, Christlike love endures opposition with confidence in God's eternal promises.

### The Servant Leader Exemplifies
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B190320/the-servant-leader-exemplifies
Passage: 1 Timothy 4:12
Points:
- Christian leaders must avoid hypocrisy because sinful living undermines the credibility of their teaching.
- Setting an example provides believers with a visible, reliable pattern of godliness to imitate.
- Leaders earn respect through truthful speech, righteous conduct, and self-sacrificing love.
- Faithfulness and moral purity guard ministry integrity and display genuine spiritual virtue to a watching world.
